question: Walk me through the period-end close cycle described in Group Reporting part 2.

scene.title: Group Reporting period-end close cycle

narration.text: Part 2 treats the close as a chain of steps. Each step has to pass a check before the next one can run.
First the Data Monitor collects the data. Then it carries balances forward and calculates net income.
Next comes a check on the reported data. That's task 1180. If it fails, someone fixes the errors and runs it again.
Once that passes, currency translation runs as task 1100. Then the standardized data gets its own check.
After that, the Consolidation Monitor takes over. It handles intercompany elimination, adjustments and a final check before the group financials are released.
